Description

Specs: The FR107 General-Purpose Rectifier Diode is a reliable high-voltage diode designed for power supply and rectification applications. With a maximum forward current of 1A and a maximum reverse voltage of 1000V, it is suitable for circuits that require dependable high-voltage rectification and moderate current handling. It can be used in power supplies, DC-DC converters, battery chargers, high-voltage rectification circuits, and other general-purpose electronic applications. Its low forward voltage drop, high surge current capability, and robust construction make it a practical choice for electronic repairs, replacements, and power circuits.
